envelope.fact: Official UI processData reads productId/category and profiles/macros envelopes. decodeDataObject base64-decodes payload, parses JSON, verifies checksum, and applies the envelope name.

checksum.fact: MD5 of recursively sorted-key JSON after removing root hash and gamemode. An integrity checksum, not a signature or device identity. Original implementation checked against standard vectors and the retained MIT public export.

dpi.fact: XML DPIStages.Active becomes JSON active=Active+1. Rows preserve XY, independent, visible from per-row Active, and zero-based index. Exact model default JSON active3 corresponds to XML/native active2. Hidden/reordered/disabled/inconsistent tables block.

model_defaults.fact: Exact182 declares vendor5426, product182, dongle183, MOUSE. Default JSON has mappings=[] and five visible stages. Retained XML supplies both layers of eight exact physical input defaults.
model_defaults.limit: These facts do not prove sparse export/application merge semantics. No automatic default expansion is enabled.

mapping_bridge.fact: XML MappingGroup selects keyboard/mouse/sensitivity/disable/media/Hypershift/macro groups. Keyboard bridge retains key token, category and modifier metadata. Full object-form modifiers, turbo and unsupported source options remain blocked.

media.fact: Seven supported names: NextTrack, PrevTrack, MediaStop, Play, MuteVolume, VolumeUp, VolumeDown. Other media names remain unsupported.

profile_defaults.fact: DEFAULTPROFILE contains numeric powerSavingValue5 and lowPowerMode5. It also contains unsupported lighting placeholders. The defaults object alone does not prove that those fields are owned or updated by a profile export.

device_storage_load.fact: The load-data loop iterates the device storage root. Its profiles branch loads brightness, dpiStages, quickEffects, switchOffLighting, pollingRate(/Wireless), and mappings. Separate root branches load calibration, powerSavingValue and lowPowerMode. Calibration dispatches smartTracking into calibration reducers.
device_storage_load.limit: This root is a device storage message, not a captured exported Synapse4 envelope. Moving its fields into either an export envelope or decoded profile payload is unproved.

power_controls.fact: Sleep UI uses powerSavingValue with integer slider1..15 and a localized minutes description. Low-power UI uses lowPowerMode with percentage labels, integer range5..100 step5; its live reducer starts at30, distinct from DEFAULTPROFILE lowPowerMode5.
power_controls.limit: The ON_SET_POWER_SAVING_VALUE and ON_SET_LOW_POWER_MODE messages pass values to middleware. The retained renderer does not show an XML SleepModeInSeconds/BatteryLevel-to-export conversion. Factory sleep300 versus UI5 is correlation, not independent proof of an export unit/ownership bridge.

calibration_controls.fact: The smart-only reducer stores smartTracking with isAsymmetric, trackingDistance, liftOffDistance and landingDistance; UI defaults are false/2/13/12. UI constrains Standard tracking to1..3 and asymmetric lift2..26, landing1..25 with landing<lift. Updates post complete merged smartTracking to middleware.
calibration_controls.limit: These are device-feature UI/storage values. The retained code does not establish a calibration member in the exported profile payload, nor a lossless profile representation of inactive Standard and Pro values. Typed SensorCalibrationV2 XML/native facts do not establish this JSON export placement.

xml_migration.fact: The XML-to-profile helper Ue handles LedBrightness, PollingRate, LedPowerSettings, DPIStages, DPI, LightingEffects and Mappings. It has no PowerManagement, LowPowerMode or SensorCalibrationV2 case. It begins by copying DEFAULTPROFILE, so leftover power defaults must not be interpreted as migrated source settings.

export_boundary.fact: The export reducer passes selectedProfiles to middleware; processData/decodeDataObject accepts the decoded profile object after checksum verification. Neither boundary establishes which separate device feature values middleware includes in each exported payload.
export_boundary.required_evidence: Exact retained middleware export/apply serializer or a captured exact-model export plus independently established feature ownership, units, completeness and inactive-value semantics.

twin_xml.fact: PowerManagement.xml, LowPowerMode.xml and SensorCalibrationV2.xml are byte-identical between retained wired and stock-receiver defaults; hashes are listed above. This does not make a v4 JSON feature schema proven.

device_feature_context_audit.decision: Power/calibration import remains blocked for both exact transports, even for complete or default-looking values. Specific diagnostics identify the unresolved source context; original raw data is retained. No device setting or RGB is invented.

json_bridge.fact: The XML sensitivity-group bridge copies SensitivityAssignment, X, Y and Independent into sensitivityAssignment, x, y and independent without collapsing axes.

obm_conversion.fact: The exact182 onboard sensitivity converter retains both source x and y for DPI_Clutch; this is an additional logical-feature confirmation, not a captured export.

sensitivity_clutch.native_record: Independent-axis native setter construction is confirmed separately in retained B6 and B7 serializers: sensitivity group4/case4 emits06 05 05 Xhi Xlo Yhi Ylo. The exact DA codec accepts the pair; other model codecs do not inherit this new variant.
sensitivity_clutch.import_semantics: Explicit independent:true produces DpiFunction::ShiftXY{x,y}, including equal axes to preserve source/UI intent. Uniformfalse/omitted flags retain legacyShift(value). Unequal axes require explicittrue; invalid ranges, off50DPIstep values and unknown group options block the complete profile.
sensitivity_clutch.equal_axes: Equal-axis native readback canonically remains legacyShift(value) with unchanged seven-byte records. Persisted source/UI profiles retain explicitShiftXY intent; native verification compares exact encoded records.
sensitivity_clutch.limits: Strict reconstructed Synapse4 subset, both exact transports and layers; all16 canonical records still required. No real export capture, hardware capture, hostmacrobridge or RGB added.
